description: Get directly held StakedSui positions and principal, now or at as_of. Historical budget stops return a continuation; totals stay null until replay finishes. Excludes wrapped stakes and liquid-staking tokens.

as_of.description: ISO 8601 date or checkpoint string; holdings at the end of the last checkpoint at or before it.

continuation.description: Opaque historical replay state from continue_with; keep address, as_of and network unchanged.

detail.description: summary caps displayed positions; full returns every read position.

max_positions.description: Directly held staking positions scanned (default 1,000); raise when the current holdings walk stopped at its bound.

max_transactions.description: Historical replay budget per direction (default 1000); also bounds object-change pages.

position_cursor.description: Opaque cursor from position_scan_next_call; returns the next block of directly held staking positions. Combine block counts; totals stay null for a partial walk.

name: get_staking_summary
title: Get staking summary
